cover.headline: 81% of marketers want integrated AI. Only 45% get it.

slides.heading: The integration gap is the agency gap
slides.body: 81% of marketers want AI capabilities integrated across creative, media, commerce and earned. Only 45% say their current partners deliver it. That 36-point gap is not a technology problem — it is an orchestration problem.

slides.heading: Close the gap, capture the budget
slides.body: 97% of marketers say they would increase spend with a partner who actually closes the cross-channel AI gap. The opportunity is sitting in front of every agency and consultancy that can unify the workflow.

slides.heading: Agentic AI is where the next two years go
slides.body: 74% of marketers plan to increase investment in agentic AI channels over the next two years. Only 21% fund this from new budget — 45% reallocate from paid media, 35% from brand budgets. The money is already moving.

slides.heading: The unit of transformation is the workflow
slides.body: BCG and Google's conclusion is not 'adopt more tools.' It is: agencies that use AI to unify fragmented operations into a single orchestration layer win. That is what we build — the Madison Avenue playbook, encoded as agents.
